recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被成片的漿細胞樣腫瘤細胞取代，細胞核偏心、卵圓形，部分核仁明顯，細胞質略嗜雙染；左下殘存少量深染的紅血球系前驅細胞，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤廣泛浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of neoplastic plasma cells replacing marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula
Eccentric round to oval nuclei; many immature forms with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; interstitial streaming of cells in areas
Residual clusters of erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei (lower left)
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a bony trabecula at right. The intertrabecular space is replaced by diffuse sheets of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric oval nuclei, open chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with scattered mitoses. Only small residual clusters of erythroid precursors remain. Fibrosis cannot be assessed on H&E alone and should be evaluated with a reticulin stain. Findings are consistent with extensive involvement by plasma cell myeloma, confirmed by CD138 and light chain/heavy chain (IgD) immunostains.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with mast cells, not monotonous sheets of immature plasma cells, and is CD20 positive with MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with plasmablastic features
ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma has larger immunoblastic cells with high proliferation and often EBER positivity, typically outside a myeloma clinical picture with M-protein and lytic lesions.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with desmoplasia and is cytokeratin positive, whereas myeloma cells are discohesive and CD138/light chain restricted.
